turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I get up to pee three times a night. It's ruining my sleep.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try to drink most of your water earlier in the day, and slow down in the last two hours before bed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. We need a stroller before the baby comes and the shop had about forty of them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's overwhelming, I know. Will you mostly be on city pavements and buses, or out on gravel paths and rough ground?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, did you take the blue pieces? I'm missing two.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, I'm red. Check under the board.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Found one. Where's the other one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe the dog took it again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no. Can we use a coin instead for now?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, a coin is fine. Your turn, by the way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Phew, that's sorted. I'm back, carry on.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We'd narrowed the stroller down to where you'll use it. Town or trails?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do drink a huge glass right before bed.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's probably part of it. Tea and alcohol in the evening can also make it worse.
